S/SM-SERIES ENVIRONMENTAL TEST CHAMBERS
Product catalog summary
Overview: Thermotron's S-Series Environmental Test Chambers are designed for precise and customizable environmental testing. They feature the 8200+ Controller, offering a wide range of temperature and humidity settings, and are available in various sizes and configurations.
Specifications: The chambers come in sizes ranging from 4 to 32 cubic feet. They offer temperature-only (S models) and temperature-humidity (SM models) options. The temperature range for S models is -70°C to 180°C, while SM models range from -68°C to 180°C. Humidity control ranges from 10% to 98% RH, with a control tolerance of ±2.5% RH.
Features: Key features include a heated window, self-contained refrigeration system, hermetically sealed compressors, and a door-mounted 8200+ Controller. Additional options include extra shelving, custom access ports, and humidity purification systems.
Controller: The 8200+ Controller is user-friendly, featuring a 7-inch color touchscreen and Windows-like interface. It supports data export via USB and offers network accessibility through built-in Ethernet capabilities.
Service and Support: Thermotron provides extensive post-purchase support, including technical advice, troubleshooting, and maintenance services. Factory-trained engineers are available globally for equipment setup and service.
Performance: The chambers are designed for standard laboratory conditions, with performance specifications based on 60Hz and 23.9°C ambient air. Cooling and heating rates vary by model, with detailed specifications provided for each.
Additional Options: Optional features include dry air or nitrogen purge, low humidity packages, and various interface options like GPIB or RS-232/485.
General Notes: Specifications are subject to change, and performance may vary slightly under different ambient conditions. Noise levels are measured under specific conditions, and additional accessories may affect performance.

S/SM-SERIES ENVIRONMENTAL TEST CHAMBERS
Thermotron’s S-Series Environmental Test Chambers deliver the quality and accuracy you expect from a premier worldwide environmental test equipment manufacturer. Featuring the 8200+ Controller, wide temperature and humidity ranges, and multiple chamber sizes and performance configurations, Thermotron’s S-Series Environmental Test Chamber is the ideal choice for quality and customizable simulated environmental testing. S-Series Environmental Test Chambers are designed in multiple sizes, ranging from 4–32 cubic feet, and performance configurations. Both temperature only (S models) and temperature humidity (SM models) chambers utilize hermetically sealed compressors that provide moderate temperature change rates while consuming less power than comparable test chambers.
